title: Q8
description:
“In bringing many sons to glory.”
Read: Exo 4:22, Hos 11:1, Psa 8:5
a) Israel was called Yahweh's son and was brought out of Egypt toward the land. What does that exodus background bring to “many sons” being led to glory (the glory and honour of Psa 8:5, in the world to come of 2:5)?
